FlowDefinition.description:
Products: Cross Border Payments - FWXB1000
Migrated from the [Opp Product] B2B XB Utilization Calculation process using multiple criteria. ARR Calculation for "Cross Border - Commercial" with Utilization and Estimated Annual Money Moved. Added ByPass to skip validation rules on Opportunity 05/14/2024. Update to make currency conversion and filter by product code; renewals should not generate ARR; use Ship_To_Account__r 07/24/2024. Use Quote_Line_Type__c instead of Opportunity.Type 07/26/2024. BOPI-511 Updated to calculate ARR when Quote Line Type not 'Cancellation' or 'Renewal'. BOPI-518 removing Opp criteria filters to let the flow run when renewals are created and the quote line fields are empty. BOPI-603 updated to set ARR to 0 for cancelled lines. BOPI-620 updated to set the ARR for cancelled lines to the original amount as a negative value BOPI-857 Allow reps to set ARR to $0 SALDEV-1184 updated formulas for B2B XB ARR, UtilizationRevenueText, Added new Decision for "New" Quote Lines and Added an "End" if it didnt meet any criteria. SALDEV-1277 – updated formula for constant 4% on FX version ≠ bank transfer SALDEV-1312 - updated formulas again for constant 4% on FX version, broke out Same Currency into separate formulas for amount and percent based usage amounts.
